changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ItemAssignment') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[ItemAssignment]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ItemID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [ResourceObject] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ResourceObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [ItemStepID] [bigint] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowItemAssignment] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemAssignment_WorkflowItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemAssignment] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemAssignment_WorkflowItem] FOREIGN KEY([ItemID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[Item] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemAssignment] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemAssignment_WorkflowItem] END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemAssignment_ItemID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ItemAssignment_ItemID] ON [workflow].[ItemAssignment] ([ItemID] ASC ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemAssignment_ItemID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_ItemAssignment_ItemID] ON [workflow].[ItemAssignment] END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemAssignment_resourceobject_resourceobjectid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ItemAssignment_resourceobject_resourceobjectid] ON [workflow].[ItemAssignment] (resourceobject,resourceobjectid) INCLUDE (itemid,itemstepid); END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemAssignment_resourceobject_resourceobjectid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_ItemAssignment_resourceobject_resourceobjectid] ON [workflow].[ItemAssignment] END
